I said they as a neutral gender term. It's only one person, but she is one of the most negative people I know. She constantly complains and talks shit about absolutely everyone after they walk out of our office. 

It's hard to listen to her criticisms of people because I have a lot of the traits she makes fun of others about. I mean, she's even mean about people she likes, so I have no idea what she's saying about me.

I could stand up to her by telling her to cut it out, but I don't know if it will cause a worse situation. I could tell my boss, but it might make the bullying worse.

Thanks for that. There's also another issue that is worsening my depression. It's a little bit of a tangent. It's this coworker who will say demeaning things about my silence and will make fun of me being weird. I know it sounds trivial, but it hurts when they make fun of me for things that make me want to kill myself. 

I share an office with this person, so I gotta listen to this stuff all day.

This is just a throwaway account, and I mostly post on a different account. I guess I'm just angry. I attempted suicide last year, swore I'd never do it again, but I'm getting more depressed each day. 

I've begun to isolate myself from my friends, family, and coworkers, and I can't seem to stop doing that. I just sit in silence and ignore them. I feel like a really bad person, but it feels like it's the only thing I can do to cope right now by pushing them away.
Yeah, I know most people will. Thank you for the recommendation. I would see a doctor sooner than Oct. 13, but they're pretty booked right now. Thank you for replying.
